# Neorender FW 1.0.1

Neorender FW 1.0.1 is a targeted Stable bugfix release.

## Fixed

- Support reports can be copied from the device web interface served over the local HTTP connection. The UI keeps the modern Clipboard API path and uses a browser-compatible fallback when that API is unavailable outside a secure context.

## Scope

This release contains no renderer, network, tuning, storage, factory-image or automatic-update policy changes.
